description: This file contains utility functions for converting values using APoT nonuniform quantization methods, including functions for float to APoT conversion, quantization/dequantization, and APoT to float conversion.

methods.name: float_to_apot(x, levels, indices, alpha)
methods.description: Converts a floating point input into an APoT number based on quantization levels, clipping values based on alpha.

methods.name: quant_dequant_util(x, levels, indices)
methods.description: Converts a floating point input into a reduced precision floating point value based on quantization levels.

methods.name: apot_to_float(x_apot, levels, indices)
methods.description: Converts an APoT input into a floating point number based on quantization levels.
